scenarios.title: Run review without API readiness
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the Analyze change button is enabled even if API readiness state is null or false, allowing review submission without API ready check.

scenarios.title: Clear diff functionality
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that clicking the Clear diff button empties the diff input and clears review results and error messages.

scenarios.title: Load example diff loads correct content
scenarios.purpose: Verify that clicking the Load example diff button populates the diff textarea with sample content containing 'Invoice not found' text.

scenarios.title: Display error message when API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Check that when API readiness is false, the setup inline message about configuring environment variables is shown on the page.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.

scenarios.title: Regression test plan generation requires input
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the Generate Playwright plan button is disabled when there is no diff or pull request URL input and enabled when either is present and API is ready.
